Nostr is an open network without accounts. RidePlan can publish a ride there so anyone can find it, and bring you new versions of rides you follow. RidePlan runs no server: rides go to public relays run by others.
Nothing is sent until you tap Publish or check a ride
A published ride is public, copied to several servers you do not control, and cannot be really deleted. Private zones and the first and last km are removed as in every other way of sharing.
Your key stays in the signer app: RidePlan never sees it
Publishing needs a signer app such as Amber, which keeps your key
Public servers that keep and pass on rides. They see your IP address and what you publish.
